title: quercus glauca subsp. euglauca
intro: Quercus glauca subsp. euglauca, commonly known as Japanese evergreen oak, is a plant species that belongs to the Quercus genus. It is prized for its medicinal properties, which include its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and act as an antioxidant, providing various health benefits such as reducing the risk of cardiovascular disease and certain types of cancer. The therapeutic actions of Quercus glauca subsp. euglauca include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which can aid in treating conditions like respiratory infections and skin disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal effects and are responsible for its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities.
